meaning: (When Summoned)
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 12-2-1-6-1: activates when the Spirit is Summoned.

meaning: (When Attacks)
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 12-2-1-7-1: Triggered Effect when it attacks during your Attack Step.

meaning: When your X attacks
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 58 (ETR:effects.simultaneous): effects that activate on one event are ordered here (constant before timed, the turn player orders the rest); the trigger itself is card text naming the ally.

meaning: When your X is blocked
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 30 (ETR:battle.block): block-timing effects trigger after the block is declared and performed, which is the event this card text watches.

meaning: When your target Spirit is summoned (Neo-Core Charge)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 24 (ETR:cost.paying): the summon it watches pays its cost and puts cores on the card; Neo-Core Charge itself is card text (docs/manual-notes.md "Blue Nuadha card-text terms").

meaning: (When Advents)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 58 (ETR:effects.simultaneous): Advent is not a summon (keyword glossary in packages/engine/src/00-config.js; docs/manual-notes.md "Costs and summons"), and the (When Advents) trigger is card text that resolves as a timed effect.

meaning: (Start of Your Attack Step)
rule: Standard Rule Manual p. 5, JP ver 1.1 (SJP:turn): the step list and what each step does; a start-of-step head is card text that fires once when the step begins.

meaning: When your X reduces the opposing Life
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 30 (ETR:battle.resolution): an unblocked attack takes Life equal to the attacker symbols; a trigger on that event is card text.

meaning: When your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the opponent
pattern: destroyed by the opponent|depleted by the opponent
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 12-2-1-12 (STD:12-2-1-12): "destroyed by the opponent" needs an opposing effect or a BP comparison with an opposing Spirit; depletion is not destruction (ETR:cores.depletion).

meaning: When the opposing Hand increases
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 10 (ETR:setup): the opening hand and the Draw Step (SJP:turn) are the only draws; watching an opposing Hand increase is card text.

meaning: [During Set] when a Life is reduced
example: Other Mirage triggers (Flash, Soul State) are not wired
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 49 (ETR:burst-area): a Mirage sits in the Burst Area outside the Field; a [During Set] effect that watches a Life decrease is card text.

meaning: When revealed from the deck
rule: Eternal manual VER.17.0 has no timing rule; v0.33 ruling: resolves at once while the revealing effect resolves. Magic reveals do not fire it yet.

meaning: When your X destroys an opposing Spirit
rule: Eternal manual p. 30-31: battle destruction after BP comparison; destructions by effects do not fire it yet.

meaning: Deploy/summon this from the Hand when your X is blocked
pattern: is blocked, you can deploy this card from the Hand
rule: Eternal manual p. 30: activates with the other effects after the block is declared.

meaning: [Main] / (Flash) activated abilities
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.2: Main effects only in your Main Step; Flash effects in the Main Step and at Flash Timing. A (Flash) with '(Either Attack Step)' is Flash Timing only. Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 9-1-7-1-2.

meaning: Draw N cards
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 10 (ETR:setup): Deck to Hand at setup and in the Draw Step (SJP:turn); an effect draws the same way (SJP:effects).

meaning: Your counter +N
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 60: Count Area cores come from the Void (engine: takeFromVoid, v0.29); this is not 'adding cores from the Void'.

meaning: Destroy an opposing Spirit with BP N or less
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 5-10-1: destroyed by an effect or BP comparison -> pending state -> Trash.

meaning: Destroy an opposing Nexus
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 22 (ETR:main.nexus): Nexus deployment; destroying a Nexus by an effect follows the card text, while Spirit destruction follows ETR:battle.destruction.

meaning: Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the Hand
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 31 (ETR:battle.destruction): returning a card to the Hand is not destruction, and a card leaving the Field waits in Standby first (docs/manual-notes.md, JP 17.0 revision notice item 4).

meaning: Banish
example: Not available as an effect action
rule: Engine: a banished card goes to the Banished zone (removed from the game). The Eternal Rule Manual 17.0 text available online does not define Banish; re-check against the 17.1 PDF.

meaning: +N BP this turn
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 68 (ETR:faq.bp): BP changes stack on the current level and a Spirit at 0 BP is destroyed only by a card clause; printed numbers never go below zero (STD:1-4-6).

meaning: Refresh a Spirit
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 5-14-1 / 5-15-1: Refresh = Exhausted to Refresh state; Exhaust = Refresh to Exhausted state.

meaning: +1 core to this card
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 22 (ETR:main.moving-cores): cores move from the Reserve or the Void (ETR:cost.paying); Count cores are a separate pool outside the Field (ETR:count).

meaning: Cores from the Trash to cards/Reserve
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 20 (ETR:turn.refresh-step): Trash cores return to the Reserve at the Refresh Step; an effect may make that move earlier (card text).

meaning: Cores to/from the Void
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 4-8-1/4-8-2: the Void is the supply of Cores and has no limit; when it runs out, cores are added from outside the game (engine: takeFromVoid, v0.29). Eternal Rule Manual sec.11: +X cores from the Void onto a Grandwalker Nexus does not count as increasing Cores from the Void. Eternal Rule Manual (Cores and the Soul Core): the Soul Core can never be placed in the Void; it stays where it is and another core goes instead.

meaning: Enter / leave Soul State
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.10: no Lv, no cores, symbols cannot reduce costs, cannot attack or block; not in the Trash, so destruction Bursts cannot trigger.

meaning: Summon/deploy without paying the cost
rule: Official: a plain "summon/deploy" effect still pays the cost (with cost reduction); only text saying "without paying the cost" is free (Eternal manual, summon/deploy).

meaning: Summon/deploy by paying the cost (cost reduction applies)
rule: Official (Eternal manual): Revive/Revival also deploys the Grandwalker Nexus by paying its cost.

meaning: Return a card from the Trash to the Hand
pattern: from your Trash to the Hand|from the Trash to the Hand
rule: Standard Rule Manual p. 4, JP ver 1.1 (SJP:basics): the Trash is a public pile and cards leave it only by an effect.

meaning: Reveal N cards from the decktop and pick
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 58 (ETR:effects.simultaneous): revealing Deck cards is an effect; the ruling since v0.33 is that it resolves at once inside the revealing effect (docs/manual-notes.md "Effects").

meaning: Send cores from your Spirits to this Spirit
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 22 (ETR:main.moving-cores): cores move between your cards in the Main Step; "Awaken" with its printed limit is card text.

meaning: Send Life to the Reserve
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 30 (ETR:battle.resolution): a reduced Life sends its cores to the Reserve; the same move by an effect is card text.

meaning: Exhaust / depletion effects
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 60-61: Exhaust turns a Refreshed card sideways; only a Refreshed card can be exhausted by an Exhaust effect (an Exhausted target is not a valid target); it is not Heavy Exhaust.

meaning: Opponent discards
rule: Standard Rule Manual p. 4, JP ver 1.1 (SJP:basics): a card leaves a hidden Hand for the Trash by an effect, and its owner picks.

meaning: Extra symbol / symbol change
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 13 (ETR:card.symbols): symbols drive cost reduction and Life damage and include God and Ultimate symbols; extra or changed symbols are card text.

meaning: End the Attack Step
rule: Standard Rule Manual p. 5, JP ver 1.1 (SJP:turn): the Attack Step and where it sits; effects already pending resolve first (ETR:effects.simultaneous); ending the step early is card text.

meaning: Seal
engine: SEAL action; manifest/contractAdvent "seal":true; fxIf sealed; p.lifeSoul
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p.49 (Seal): Seal moves your Soul Core from the stated place to your Life; while that Soul Core is in your Life you are Sealed and [During Seal] effects can be used. Using Seal is optional. When Life is reduced with a normal core and the Soul Core in Life, the player chooses which leaves (engine: normal cores first).

meaning: If your Life is N or less
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 10 (ETR:setup): Life is a core count in the Life area; a condition on it is card text.

meaning: Counter N or more / C-cost
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 22 (ETR:main.nexus): counters are put on Nexuses by effects; Count cores are a separate Void-fed pool (ETR:count); a counter threshold is card text.

meaning: If you control (incl. Soul State) a named card
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 54 (ETR:contract.soul-state): "control" means on your Field and a Soul State card is not on the Field, which is why the engine has an explicit incl.-Soul-State form.

meaning: (Once per Turn: Same Name)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual FAQ Q9: [Once per turn] is per card; [Once per turn: Same Name] is shared by all same-name cards. Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 12-3-1-1.

meaning: Opposing turn / Your turn
example: Your Turn limit on Flash only partly
rule: Standard Rule Manual p. 5, JP ver 1.1 (SJP:turn): one seat holds the turn at a time; "opposing turn" is a card-text timing.

meaning: [LV1][LV2] level gating
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 27 (ETR:cores.depletion): levels are core thresholds and too few cores is depletion, not destruction; a [LV1][LV2] head is printed on the card.

meaning: Must block if possible
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 30 (ETR:battle.block): one untapped Spirit or Ultimate may block; "must block if possible" is card text on top of that.

meaning: Can't be returned from the Field
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 31 (ETR:battle.destruction): every way of leaving the Field goes through Standby first (docs/manual-notes.md, JP 17.0 revision notice item 4); a lock against being returned is card text.

meaning: Draw when cores are sent to this Spirit
pattern: When cores are sent to this Spirit
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 22 (ETR:main.moving-cores): cores moving onto a Field card; drawing on that event is card text.

meaning: Unaffected by opposing effects
engine: STATIC flag UNAFFECTED {to: self|own, match, from: {colors, types}} (v0.58) and UNAFFECTED_SOUL (Ometeotl) via fxImmune(owner, target, acting effect); every FX_ACTIONS cands list skips immune opposing targets (02k-effects-immunity.js); HAND_UNAFFECTED (your Hand), card flags handUnaffected / trashUnaffected
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.6: ignores all effects except those listed (e.g. Grandwalker Nexus only by its own / Grandwalker-targeting effects; Soul State cards only by Soul State-targeting effects). Priority (FAQ Q3): cannot be prevented > unaffected > cannot activate. Engine v0.58: unaffected by OPPOSING effects whose source card matches the colours/types; conditional forms (while exhausted, During Seal, While ... in your Trash) and 'this effect is unaffected' are not built yet.

meaning: Can't be prevented/negated
engine: action flag ignoreImmune (DESTROY coresLe since v0.39; every cands list honours it since v0.58)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 62 (ETR:faq.effects-q3): effect priority: "cannot" beats "must" beats "may/do"; "cannot be prevented" beats "unaffected" beats "cannot activate" (ETR:faq.effects-q4).

meaning: Burst
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.7: set face down from the Hand in your Main Step once per turn, no cost; one Burst in the area (a new one discards the old one); activation is optional; Magic Bursts may allow a paid extra (Flash) effect.

meaning: Burst then pay to use the Flash effect
pattern: by paying the cost, activate this card's \(Flash\)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 46 (ETR:burst): a Burst activates with the other effects of its event and the Flash timings follow (SJP:flash); paying to use the Flash effect after the Burst is card text.

meaning: Mirage
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.8: set face up from the Hand in your Main Step once per turn by paying the Mirage cost; cores cannot be placed on it; its symbols cannot reduce costs; a Burst and a Mirage can both be in the Burst Area; replacing a Mirage returns the old one to the Hand.

meaning: Advent / Contract Advent
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.9: not a summon; the Soul Core moves; the Advent card stacks on the source and inherits its state and cores; Contract/Divine/Over Advent count as Advent.

meaning: Manifest / Ultra Manifest
engine: manifest {name, counterGe, turn: YOURS | EITHER_ATTACK | YOUR_ATTACK, ultra | seal}, trigger MANIFEST
rule: Eternal Rule Manual (Manifest): put the Soul Core from your Life, Field or Reserve in the Trash and pay 1 of the summon cost with a core from the target Grandwalker Nexus; the Spirit is treated as summoned by paying 1 cost. When-Manifests effects do not activate when the Manifest happens in the Main Step or the Spirit is summoned by another effect.

meaning: Revive
rule: Revive is not covered by any manual chunk read so far (docs/rules/kb.json known_gaps), so the Eternal Rule Manual and Standard Comprehensive Rules offer no text here; the engine follows the printed card text (docs/manual-notes.md "Not found in the online text yet").

meaning: Contract Field / Contract Skill
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 44 (ETR:gw.contract): and the Contract card at setup (ETR:contract.setup); the printed Contract Skill cost is card text (docs/manual-notes.md "Nexus Brave Contract Skill N").

meaning: Grandwalker Nexus core effects
example: Core Charge, Grand Skill/Field are per card
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.16: cores are placed only by Oracle/Unseal or effects that target them; cores on it go to the Void when it leaves the Field.

meaning: Over Count
rule: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 p. 61: OC is active while your Count meets the OC condition, regardless of Lv; its + value is added to BP like a combined Brave; [During OC] effects work only while it is met; [During OC & Advent] also needs the Advent state.

meaning: Brave (braving)
engine: type Brave + "brave": {bp, family, name, costGe, nexus:{name}}; combineBrave / separateBrave / braveSummon
rule: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 p. 34-36: an uncombined Brave on the Field is treated as a Spirit (summoning it is not a Spirit summon); it combines with a Spirit meeting its Brave condition in the Main Step or when summoned, at no cost; its cores move onto the Spirit; BP+, cost and symbol are added; one Brave per Spirit; it leaves the Field with the Spirit to the same place. p. 38-39: a Saga Brave ("brave.nexus") can combine with a matching Grandwalker Nexus: its cores return to the Reserve first, no cores when combined directly, Lv1 cores to separate; the Nexus gets its symbol and its [While Combined with a Nexus] effects (nexusBrave:true, v0.35). The Nexus does not take the Brave's cost/family yet.

meaning: Ultimate (card type). Since v0.46 Ultimate cards can be summoned (summon condition summonIf, LV3+ levels, Ultimate symbol), attack and block; not a Brave or Contract Advent target
engine: type Ultimate, summonIf (v0.56: lifeGe, ctrl = you control N or more colour/cost/family Spirits/Ultimates), lvBase 3, lvNo; v0.56 Ultimate Trigger action ULT_TRIGGER + condition utHit (compiler: inline [LVn] (When Attacks) form only); open: Ultimate Trigger level/timing missing in the Fandom export, Double/Triple Ultimate Trigger, Guard / Trigger Counter, effects printed for Spirits only still reach Ultimates
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.15: not affected by effects that target Spirits; affected by effects that target Cores, cards on the Field or Ultimates. U-Trigger: Hit only if the Ultimate's cost is higher than the revealed card.

meaning: Tokens
engine: data/cards/tokens.json (type "Token Spirit" -> Spirit + token:true); action SEND_TOKEN {token,n,ask}; sendToken / tokenHome; per-player Token supply
rule: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 p. 56-57 + official page "How to Use Token Cards" (battlespirits.com/product/special/tokencard): Token cards cannot be in the Deck; they are prepared before the game (no limit per kind, not refilled during the game); they go to the Field only by "send out" effects, without paying the cost, with cores for at least Lv1 from your Field or Reserve; a Token Spirit is a Spirit (attacks, blocks, is targeted by Spirit effects, can be braved); when it leaves the Field it returns to where it came from, never the Trash/Hand/Deck, so "after your Spirit is destroyed" Bursts cannot activate. Engine house choice: 10 of each Token kind a deck can send out.

meaning: Heavy Exhaust
engine: HEAVY_EXHAUST_OPP (setHeavy / refreshOne; flag heavy next to exhausted)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual pp. 60-61, FAQ p. 67 (read 2026-10-14): only an effect can Heavy Exhaust; the card is turned upside down, counts as Exhausted and cannot attack or block; one Refresh (effect or Refresh Step) turns it into a normal Exhausted card; a Refreshed or Exhausted Spirit can be Heavy Exhausted by a Heavy Exhaust effect. The engine shows it as Exhausted (the upside-down picture waits for UI approval).

meaning: Standard: Succession / Soul Magic / Shinkai-ho
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 12-2-1-2 (STD:12-2-1-2): Soul Magic also per SJP:soul-magic; Inherit (Succession) Summon per SJP:inherit; Shinkai-ho is not covered by a manual chunk and follows the printed text.

meaning: Seal (Sealed state)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.19: Seal moves your Soul Core from a specified place to your Life; 'Sealed' effects check the Soul Core in your Life. Standard Comprehensive Rules 5-7-3: the Soul Core can go to Life/Void only when an effect targets it. Engine: needs the Soul Core to be able to sit in the Life area.

meaning: Flash - High Speed: summon this card from the Hand paying the cost and its Lv1 cores from the Reserve only
engine: card "highSpeed": true; highSpeedOK / highSpeedSummon in the Flash Timing (human button, cpuHighSpeed)
rule: Engine: built from the printed card text (Fandom export, BS68-BS77); no manual rule note found yet.

meaning: Crush (When Attacks): discard cards equal to this Spirit's level from the opposing decktop
rule: Engine: built from the printed card text (Fandom export, BS68-BS77); no manual rule note found yet.

meaning: Holy Life (When Attacks): when this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, put a Void core on your Life
rule: Engine: built from the printed card text (Fandom export, BS68-BS77); no manual rule note found yet.

meaning: Ultra Holy Life (When Attacks): when blocked draw from the deckbottom; when not blocked put a Void core on your Life
rule: Engine: built from the printed card text (Fandom export, BS68-BS77); no manual rule note found yet.

meaning: Accel: use this card's Accel effect from the Hand by paying the Accel cost; the card then goes where the text says (usually the Removed Zone)
engine: ACCEL effect (cost, timing, optional reduction) used from the Hand; card then to the Removed Zone; Accel Spirits summonable from the Removed Zone in your Main Step (useAccel, summonFromRemoved)
rule: Fandom 'Accel' Q1-Q8 (the Eternal manual text read has no Accel section): used from the Hand at the printed timing by paying the Accel cost, field symbols reduce it (Q4), Hand cost changes do not (Q8); the card is revealed and put onto the Removed Zone (Q1, Q3); a Spirit there can be summoned in your Main Step by paying its cost (Q5); its Accel can't be used from there (Q6). Partial: the Accel-cost reduction icons are missing from the Fandom export, so the full cost is paid.

meaning: Silver Wheel: a Flash effect that exhausts this Spirit as its cost
engine: ACTIVATE {silverWheel, timing Main+Flash, cost exhaustSelf, once:false}; trigger SILVER_WHEEL after it resolves
rule: Printed card text (Fandom export BS70/BS71/BS76): 'Flash - Silver Wheel: You can exhaust this Spirit. When you've done so, ...'; Flash effects can be used in the Main Step and the Flash Timings (Eternal manual p.18, p.23). Partial: the Silver Wheel cards that need other missing clauses keep them as residual.

meaning: Armor / Heavy Armor / Ultra Armor: unaffected by opposing effects of the listed colours
engine: compiler unaffected_para -> STATIC UNAFFECTED from {colors, types} (v0.58)
rule: Printed keyword text (Fandom export): Armor = opposing <colour> Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects; Heavy Armor = Spirit/Brave/Nexus/Magic; Ultra Armor = Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic. Eternal manual p. 48 names Heavy/Ultra Armor as Burst preventers: a Burst of a listed colour cannot affect the card (same cands filter). Open: granted Armor ('give ... Armor', When Braved / During Brave / During OC prefixes).

meaning: Nether Immortality: when your matching "Nether" is destroyed, summon this card from the Trash
engine: (not wired; close to DESTROYED + summon from Trash)
rule: Engine: built from the printed card text (Fandom export, BS68-BS77); no manual rule note found yet.

meaning: (When Blocks): this Spirit blocks
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 12-2-1-9-1: Triggered Effect when it blocks during the opponent's Attack Step. Eternal manual p. 30: activates after the block is declared, before BP is compared.

meaning: (When Destroyed)
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 12-2-1-12: activates when the Spirit or Nexus is destroyed. Eternal manual p. 31: resolves before the card goes to the Trash; engine resolves right after with the level it had.

meaning: 'You can' = optional; 'You do' = mandatory
rule: Eternal Rule Manual FAQ Q2: 'you can/may' is optional; 'you do' must be done whenever possible. Burst activation is optional.

meaning: 'By doing X, do Y': X is a requirement
rule: Eternal Rule Manual FAQ (About Effects in General) Q5: you must perform X for the effect to activate, X cannot be performed when Y cannot be performed, and the player chooses whether to activate the effect. Q6: "you can do X; if you do, do Y" does Y as far as possible.

meaning: 'You can X. If you do / When you've done so, Y'
rule: Eternal Rule Manual FAQ Q6: the effect works even if Y cannot be done.

meaning: 'Then': the next part resolves even if the previous part could not
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 5-19-1.

meaning: 'Up to X' can be 0
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 1-4-5-1.

meaning: (Can't Stack): same effect cannot activate more than once at the same timing
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 12-3-2-1.

meaning: 'Instead' = replacement effect
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 9-1-8-1: a replaced event cannot be replaced again.

meaning: Priority: cannot > must > do = can; cannot be prevented > unaffected > cannot activate
engine: v0.58: can't-block removes blockers before MUST_BLOCK; unaffected Spirits are not bound by MUST_BLOCK; ignoreImmune beats unaffected
rule: JP 17.0 revision notice item 9: 'cannot' > 'must' > 'do' = 'can' (do and can no longer outrank each other). Eternal Rule Manual FAQ A3/A4 (Q3). Card text beats the basic rules.

meaning: Simultaneous triggers: continuous effects first, then triggered; the turn player orders within a category
rule: Eternal Rule Manual sec.5. Same event hitting several cards at once triggers an effect only once (Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 9-1-5-4).

meaning: Targets are chosen when the effect resolves and are not changed if they stop matching
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 9-3-2.

meaning: send your Soul Core to a named Grandwalker Nexus
rule: Eternal Rule Manual (Cores and the Soul Core): the Soul Core can only be in the Reserve, on a card on the Field or in the Trash; the engine takes it from the Trash, the Reserve or a card it can leave without depleting a Spirit.

meaning: when your Soul Core is sent/placed on your Nexus
rule: Engine: card text trigger (Ometeotl Contract Field, Sphinott-Hauser, Magmazosia); the timing words (Your/Either Attack Step) use the attackStep / oppTurn conditions.

meaning: (When Manifests)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual (Manifest): activates with the summon effects; not when the Manifest happens in the Main Step or the Spirit is summoned by another effect.

meaning: destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total BP
pattern: up to a total of \d+ BP
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 1.0 5-10-1: destroyed by an effect. Ultimates are not in the engine yet.

meaning: send out a Token from your Token supply
rule: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 p. 56 and the official "How to Use Token Cards" page, rule 2: only a "send out a Token" effect puts a Token on the Field; no cost is paid; cores for at least Lv1 come from your Field or Reserve; it is not a summon.

meaning: this Spirit gains extra symbols during this battle
engine: SYMBOL_PLUS (inst.symBattle, cleared when the battle ends)
rule: Symbols decide how many Life an unblocked attacker takes (Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 attack step); the gain lasts only for this battle (card text).

meaning: destroy, and the effects of the destroyed target can't activate
pattern: effects of the destroyed target can't activate
rule: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 p. 31 gives (When Destroyed) effects; this card text overrides it: the destroyed card's own effects do not activate.

meaning: destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate by cost: Cost N or less, cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's / the discarded card's, or the lowest/highest cost
engine: DESTROY costLe | costLeSelf | costLeDiscarded | costRank | costBoost
rule: Card text (cardrush-bs.jp BS71-057, BS72-054); the Eternal Rule Manual defines no rule for the term "Cost Destruction effect". Limits grow with COST_DESTROY_PLUS effects; lowest/highest cost destruction is not a Cost Destruction effect and has no limit.

meaning: increase the limit of your Cost Destruction effects (Bulwark Temple, Railgun on a Nexus)
pattern: increase the limit of your .{0,40}Cost Destruction
engine: STATIC flag COST_DESTROY_PLUS {n, perSagaBrave, srcFamily, nexusBrave}
rule: Card text (cardrush-bs.jp BS71-072, BS74-067); the Eternal Rule Manual defines no rule for it. The bonus applies to limit-based destruction only.

meaning: draw N cards, then discard M cards from the Hand (extra draws and fewer discards under conditions)
rule: Card text; the Eternal Rule Manual p. 31 style of resolution applies (effects resolve in order). Discarding is from the Hand to the Trash; the CPU discards its cheapest card.

meaning: Neo-Core Charge Contract Field: instead of +1 core to the Nexus, +1 counter
pattern: instead of \+1 core to it, you can \+1 counter
rule: Card text (cardrush-bs.jp BS71-CX03); the Eternal Rule Manual defines Neo-Core Charge only through the card. Brave-summon variant only when the Brave is summoned as a Spirit.

meaning: [During Brave]: the effect works only while a Brave is combined with this Spirit
rule: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 pp. 34-36 (Brave): a combined Brave belongs to the Spirit; the gate checks that a Brave is combined.

meaning: an effect summons a Brave card (from the Hand or revealed cards) as a Spirit without paying the cost
rule: Eternal Rule Manual VER.17.0 pp. 34-36: an uncombined Brave is a Spirit. Direct combining by an effect and summon from the Trash are not built yet.

meaning: When cards are put onto the opposing Removed Zone
pattern: put onto the opposing Removed Zone|put onto the opposing Removed Zone|opposing Removed Zone
rule: Card text of BS69-BS70 (Hermes deck). The Eternal Rule Manual text read on 2026-10-14 defines no Removed Zone rule; the engine keeps p.removed (the Banished zone of A_BANISH) and fires the effect once per put event.

meaning: Put onto the Removed Zone (hand, Trash, Spirit)
rule: Card text of BS69-BS70 (Hermes deck); the Eternal Rule Manual text read on 2026-10-14 has no Removed Zone rule (it lists a Set Aside zone; whether that is the same zone is not confirmed). Engine: a random card (or the opponent's choice) goes to p.removed; a Spirit sent there loses its cores to its Reserve; returning cards from the zone and 'can't use' locks are not built.

meaning: The opponent can't activate Burst effects (this battle)
engine: NO_BURST_BATTLE (G.noBurst, cleared when the battle ends)
rule: Card text (Contractor Hermes Contract Field); the Eternal Rule Manual p. 48 only names Heavy Armor / Ultra Armor as Burst preventers. Engine: maybeBurst is refused for the locked player until the battle ends; Magic/Mirage activations are unaffected.

meaning: Put a core from the Void each to several matching Spirits/Nexuses
pattern: core from the Void each to
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 11 / Standard Comprehensive Rules 4-8: the Void is the supply of cores; the cores come from the Void, one per target, targets distinct.

meaning: Send cards from the top of your Deck to the Trash (discard from the decktop)
pattern: send (one|two|three|\d+) cards? from your decktop to the Trash|discard (one|two|three|\d+) cards? from your decktop
engine: MILL (n, optional family + counter/draw); DECK_TO_TRASH_CORES for the Contractor Nexus version
rule: Eternal Rule Manual, Discarding / Trash rules: a card sent from the Deck to the Trash is a normal card movement (no Hand involved). Engine: the top n cards go to the Trash; a family hit gives counter +n and a draw (Hound-Beros).

meaning: Discard cards from your Hand (the cost of "by discarding a card from your Hand, ...")
engine: DISCARD_HAND as the cost of BY (the CPU throws away its cheapest card); match.color limits it to e.g. Purple
rule: Eternal Rule Manual FAQ, About Effects in General Q5 ("By doing X, do Y"): the cost must be performable and is not paid when the rest cannot be done. Engine: BY checks can() of the cost and of the first result before asking.

meaning: Send cores from opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the opposing Reserve
pattern: send .*cores? from .*opposing Spirits?/Ultimates? to the Reserve
rule: Eternal Rule Manual p. 28 (Depletion): a Spirit left with fewer cores than its Lv1 requirement goes to the Trash without Destruction effects. Engine: cores move to the opposing Reserve, then checkDepletion; Soul Cores are not moved; Spirits immune to opposing effects are skipped.

meaning: Counter +n, limited to once per turn inside a longer effect
pattern: then, once per turn, your counter \+\d
rule: Card text of Contractor Hades (Contract Skill 2): only the Count part is limited to once per turn, the core removal is not. Eternal Rule Manual (Count Area): Count cores come from the Void. Engine: p.onceUsed key per card name.

meaning: Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with N cores or less on it
pattern: destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with (\w+) cores? or less
rule: Card text (BS68 Sorcerers); Eternal Rule Manual: all cores on a card count, the Soul Core as well. Engine: totalCores of the target; Spirits immune to opposing effects are skipped.

meaning: An opposing Spirit/Ultimate can't attack/block during this game
engine: CANT_ATTACK_BLOCK (flag noAB on the Spirit; reset when it leaves the Field)
rule: No rule text for this term was re-read in v0.40 (the manual PDF could not be fetched in the session); built as printed on the cards. Engine: the Spirit stays on the Field but is never offered as an attacker or blocker (human and CPU); it is a Spirit for every other purpose. "During this game" is not removed at turn end; bouncing, destroying or Advent-stacking the Spirit clears it.

meaning: If any opposing Spirit is under can't attack/block effects
rule: Engine: true while any opposing Spirit carries the noAB flag.

meaning: If the opponent controls any Nexus
rule: Engine: counts the opposing Nexuses (Vajdra-of-Magan cost 3).

meaning: Draw from the bottom of the Deck
rule: Card text (Thunderive). No rule text for this term was re-read in v0.40 (the manual PDF could not be fetched in the session); built as printed on the cards. Engine: the last card of the Deck goes to the Hand; it counts as drawing (Hand increase by an own effect).

meaning: Reveal cards from the Deck top, add matching cards, discard the rest
rule: Card text of Manevajra. The Fandom text says "add a total of one Contractor Indra and Thunderive card"; built as one card matching either (+1 with the bonus condition). Unverified against the card image. Engine: built as printed on the card text.

meaning: Discard the entire Hand (at least one card)
rule: Eternal Rule Manual FAQ (About Effects in General): the cost of "by ..." must be performable; with an empty Hand nothing happens.

meaning: Put a core from the Void on your Life
pattern: put a core from the Void to your Life
rule: Card text (Naraka, Temple). Engine: Life +1 and the Void -1; not a Life reduction, no Burst.

meaning: Send one of your Lives to this Spirit
pattern: send one of your Lives to this Spirit
rule: Card text (Vajdra-of-Magan). Engine: the Life core moves to the Spirit; not a Life reduction by damage, so no Burst; the last Life cannot be sent.

meaning: Send cores from your Nexus to this Spirit
pattern: sending two cores from your .* Nexuses to this Spirit
rule: Card text (Vajrawurm Unleash cost). Engine: the Nexus must hold the cores.

meaning: Return this Spirit to your Hand
pattern: return this Spirit to the Hand
rule: Card text (Togevajdra). Engine: bounceCard to the Hand, cores to the Reserve.

meaning: All your matching cards gain an extra reduction symbol
engine: STATIC flag EXTRA_REDUCTION ({color, n, match, lv})
rule: Card text (Indra Contract Field, Shimavajdra). The extra symbol is a reduction symbol of that colour on the card being paid (effCost); the usual symbol matching of the manual (p. 25-27) still decides if it is fulfilled. Engine: built as printed on the card text.

meaning: "Your other X" and "(Can't Stack)"
rule: Card text. other: the summoned card is not this card. noStack: of several same-name cards only one copy of the effect works per event. Engine: built as printed on the card text.

meaning: SA Unleash N: when the trigger happens, you can send N cores from the named Grandwalker Nexus to this Spirit; the rest applies only when you did
rule: Engine (house reading from the card text, Fandom BS71-X09 / BS75-X10; no manual section found): "you can send N cores from your <name> Nexus to this Spirit; when you have done so, ..." - the follow-up applies only when the cores were sent.

meaning: Send opposing Life to the Trash (optionally one per differently named <family> Brave you control)
rule: Engine (house reading, v0.45): not damage; the Life cores go to the Trash, one Burst check (Life decreased), Life 0 ends the game.

meaning: (Your Attack Step) the opponent can't block
engine: OPP_NO_BLOCK {minLv} at START_ATTACK; noBlockActive() empties the blocker list while the source stays at minLv
rule: Engine (house reading, v0.45): decided once at the start of your Attack Step; reaching the level later in that step does not start it.

meaning: When your <family> Brave Spirit attacks
engine: ALLY_ATTACKS + subjBraved:<family> (attacker has a combined Brave; the Spirit or the Brave is of the family)
rule: Engine (house reading from the card text, Fandom BS71-X09): "When your Scalostle family Brave Spirit attacks" - the attacking Spirit or its combined Brave carries the family.

meaning: When this card is sent to the Trash from the Deck/Hand by the effect of your <X>: add it to the Hand and/or +1 core to a Grandwalker Nexus
pattern: is sent to (the )?Trash from (the )?(deck|Hand/Deck)|was sent to the Trash from Hand/Deck
engine: card field trashTrigger {from, by, add, gwCore}; sentToTrashFx from DECK_TO_TRASH_CORES, MILL, DISCARD_HAND
rule: Engine (card text of Whirling Tide, Thunder Counter, Hades Disaster): "+1 core" puts a core from the Void (Eternal Rule Manual, Cores: the Void is the core supply).

meaning: While you control <X>, you can use this Magic card from the Trash (then it is banished)
pattern: you can use this card from the Trash
engine: magic.trashUse {if, actions?}: magicUsable/castMagic accept a Trash card, trashUse.actions replace the effect, the card goes to the Removed Zone
rule: Engine (card text of Hades Disaster and Plutonic Wall): built as printed; the human uses it from the Flash Timing list (marked [from the Trash]).

meaning: During this turn, an opposing Spirit/Ultimate can attack/block only by sending a core from itself to the Trash
pattern: unless the opponent sends a core from the attacking/blocking
engine: AB_CORE_TAX_TURN sets opp.abTax; doBattleInner asks payAbTax for the attacker and the blocker; abTaxOK filters CPU attackers and all blockers
rule: Engine (house reading, Plutonic Wall): only a spare core can be sent; a payment that would deplete the Spirit is not offered.

meaning: When using this card, you can also use symbols from your Trash to reduce the cost
pattern: symbols from your Trash to reduce the cost
engine: card flag trashSymbols: effCost adds the symbols of Trash cards to the Field symbols
rule: Engine (card text of Lightning Tempest); reduction itself follows the Eternal Rule Manual (Cost reduction, mandatory when possible).

meaning: This card in the Hand/Removed Zone is unaffected by opposing effects
pattern: in Hand/Removed Zone is unaffected by opposing effects
engine: card flag handUnaffected: REMOVE_OPP_HAND, OPP_CHOOSES_REMOVE_HAND and OPP_DISCARD_MAGIC_OR skip it (no opposing effect acts on the Removed Zone yet)
rule: Engine (card text of Lightning Tempest).

meaning: At the start of the opposing Attack Step, by sending N cores from your <X> Grandwalker Nexus to the Void, pay the cost to use this card from the Hand
pattern: At the start of Opposing Attack Step, by sending
rule: Engine (card text of Thunder Counter); Grandwalker cores go to the Void (Eternal Rule Manual p. 44).

meaning: Burst: then by paying the cost, activate the Main effect of this card; also activates when your <family> Brave is summoned (condition)
pattern: activate the Main effect of this card|you can immediately activate this set card
engine: burst.thenMain -> burstFlash(p, inst, 'main'); burst.also {when:BRAVE_SUMMONED, match, if} -> maybeBurst from braveSummonedFx
rule: Engine (card text of Dana Draw); Burst timing per the Eternal Rule Manual (Burst).

meaning: Give opposing Spirits -N BP (this turn)
rule: No rule destroys a Spirit at 0 BP (Eternal manual FAQ p. 68: only a card's own "Then, if its BP is 0, destroy it" does); BP is shown as 0, never negative (Standard CR 1-4-6). Open: every/two opposing Spirits (lasts for Spirits summoned later this turn, FAQ p. 68 Q3), the "then destroy at 0" clause.

meaning: (When Battles) when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison
rule: Standard CR 8-1-6-2: effects for a destruction by BP comparison activate after the comparison. Open: other (When Battles) texts (effects at the start of the battle).

meaning: Rush: while you have a X symbol, the following effect activates next
rule: Engine: built from the card text only (Fandom export, BS19-BS27); no Eternal or Standard manual section found. House reading: Field symbols (as for cost reduction) at resolution. Open: Rush on Magic cards and optional Rush effects.

meaning: (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
rule: Standard CR 12-2-1-12-1: destroyed by an opposing effect or by BP comparison with an opposing Spirit. Open: (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent) (depletion is not destruction, Eternal manual p. 28).

meaning: {{Invoke|Flash}} / {{Invoke|Main}} <cost> ▶ <effect>
engine: ACTIVATE {invoke:true, timing, when, once, oncePer, cost} (v0.68, 02l-effects-invoke.js)
rule: Standard manual 'FAQ on Effects' Q11: the part before the arrow (the cost) must resolve fully, otherwise the effect is not used; timing from the template (Flash includes your Main Step), narrowed by printed heads; limits only when printed.

meaning: If your Life was reduced (during) this turn
pattern: If your Life was reduced (during )?this turn
engine: if {lifeReduced: true|false} (v0.88, 02a fxIf; lifeTake records p.lifeRedTurn)
rule: Engine reading of the Standard Magic card texts: the Life counts as reduced this turn when any core left it during the current turn, by an attack or by an effect; checked when the effect resolves. The 'X instead' riders are two actions with lifeReduced false / true. Manual reference still to find (rules audit).

meaning: If all your Spirits/Nexuses have the X family / have <Team>; If all your Spirits are Cost 2/4/6/8 with the X family
pattern: If all your Spirits(/Nexuses)? (are Cost [0-9/]+ with|have)
engine: if {allHave: {family|team|costIn, spiritsOnly}} (v0.88, 02p-effects-shared-shapes.js; teams from the [Team: X] / [Teams: X/Y] head line)
rule: Engine house reading of the Standard card texts (rules audit, 2026-10-21): every card on your Field of the named kind must match; with no such card the condition is not met (an empty Field has nothing that 'has' the family). Team = the card's printed [Team: X] attribute, like a family.

meaning: Target one of your X Spirits. Destroy it. If you've done so, ...
pattern: Target (one of your|a .+ you control).*Destroy it\. If you've done so
rule: Engine reading of the Standard card texts: own destruction by your own effect; 'If you've done so' = the next action has if {prev: true}.

meaning: During this turn, your Life can't be reduced by its attack.
pattern: your Life can't be reduced by its attack
rule: Engine reading of the Standard card texts: the targeted Spirit's unblocked attacks take no Life from you until the end of the turn; its other effects still apply.

meaning: Target an opposing Spirit. During this battle, it can block even while exhausted.
rule: Engine reading of the Standard card text (Meteor Crash): as printed, during this battle only.

meaning: When this battle ends, destroy it.
pattern: When this battle ends, destroy (it|the summoned)
rule: Engine reading of the Standard card texts: a delayed effect of a used Magic card; it resolves at the end of the battle even though the card is in the Trash.

meaning: (When you use a Magic card)
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 12-2 (Common Effects) has no entry for this event: using a Magic card is an ordinary game action (SJP:main-step). The engine fires it after the Magic resolved and does not fire it for a Burst.

meaning: If you used a X Magic card this turn
pattern: If you used (a |any |an? )[^\.]*Magic card this turn
rule: Standard Comprehensive Rules 12-2 has no numbered entry for using a Magic card (it is an ordinary game action, SJP:main-step); the engine records every Magic the player uses this turn (MAGIC_USED) and this condition reads that record.
